Package gov.cdc.izgateway.logging.event

Class PublicHealth

java.lang.Object
gov.cdc.izgateway.logging.event.PublicHealth
All Implemented Interfaces:
IHealth
public class PublicHealth extends Object implements IHealth
The health status of the server as shown to a caller that has not authenticated.

This is a deliberate allowlist rather than a redacted copy of Health: it carries only the liveness answer and the time it was taken. Everything else Health reports to authenticated callers -- host and server names, environment, ingress and egress addresses, AWS region, the database in use, the build identifier, the access control action, request and success volumes, event count, start time, startup duration, the last healthy and unhealthy timestamps, the reason for the last health change, and the message of the last exception -- has no field here and so cannot be disclosed, including when new fields are later added to Health.

Note that the exception message reaches the wire through Health's hand-written Health.getLastException(), not through the @JsonIgnored field behind it, so inspecting Health's fields alone understates what the full report carries. That is the case this allowlist is built for.

Load balancer and container probes are unaffected: they match on the HTTP status code, which is unchanged.
